items.rationale: The fixed unit is insured under §§2.3.3 and 4.2.3 and is about seven metres from the hob, outside the §2.3.10(c) exclusion. Under §7.1.9(a), one like-for-like floor-console AC unit is estimated at €1,650 gross, excluding separately billed fitting and freight.

Section 2.3.10(c) excludes surge damage to this unit because it is within five metres of the hob and there is no kitchen climate endorsement. If covered, one comparable wall-mounted unit would be estimated at €1,200 gross before separate fitting and freight.
Section 7.1.9(c) expressly covers labour to remove the damaged unit, fit and connect its replacement, and commission it. One installation is estimated at €550 gross.
Under §7.1.11, installation follows the principal item, which is excluded by §2.3.10(c). If covered, one wall-unit installation would be estimated at €500 gross.
Section 7.1.9(b) covers an equivalent mounting support because the original was scorched and could not be reused. One replacement floor console is estimated at €180 gross.

Sections 7.1.9(e), 7.1.11 and 7.1.12 cover ordinary freight only for the living-room unit's share; itemisation may be required. Using estimated unit values because no weight- or volume-based tariff is stated, €120 × €1,650 ÷ (€1,650 + €1,200) gives about €69 gross.
